definition.simple: The tissue that covers the outside of the body and lines the inside of organs, acting like a protective skin.
definition.academic: Animal tissue consisting of one or more layers of tightly packed cells that form the covering or lining of all internal and external body surfaces.

examples: The outer layer of your skin.
The inner lining of your stomach.

common_misconceptions: Thinking epithelium is only the outer skin. It also lines blood vessels and internal organs.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Epi- means 'upon' or 'over'. Epithelium covers everything!
